title: HOME STRETCH cheap-model execution backlog
description: Fifteen bounded packets that move the already-merged shared-agent workspace and Builder boundary toward the #505 daily-driver proof. DO NOT APPLY this initiative until builder-cheap-hardening-20260816-v2 has completed b4-supervisor-route-aware-launch and paid route readiness is verified. Reuse existing architecture. If current code already satisfies a packet, add only the smallest missing regression evidence. Avoid the active #509 files and do not start parked initiatives.

packets.title: Make room turns end in one truthful result state
packets.objective: Tighten shared-agent turn completion so every turn ends completed, failed, needs-user, or builder-proposed with one durable result contract rather than ambiguous partial state.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one terminal/result state is durable per turn.
Failure cannot coexist with completed success evidence.

packets.title: Make Builder proposal creation idempotent
packets.objective: Ensure retrying the same approved workspace proposal cannot create duplicate durable Builder work.
acceptance_criteria: Same proposal/approval creates at most one Builder work item.
A materially changed proposal receives a distinct identity.

packets.title: Keep proposal and execution authority separate
packets.objective: Strengthen the boundary so room agents may propose Builder work but no proposal can materialize or execute without the existing explicit approval path.
acceptance_criteria: Unapproved proposal never creates executable Builder work.
Approval identity is durably bound to the exact proposal.

packets.title: Return Builder completion in user language
packets.objective: Map a finished Builder result into a concise workspace result that says what changed, what was verified and what happens next without packet IDs or raw logs.
acceptance_criteria: Completed result includes outcome and verification evidence in plain language.
Internal IDs/logs remain available only as optional evidence, not primary copy.
validation_commands: cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run AgentWorkspacePanel

packets.title: Reduce Builder blockers to one human action
packets.objective: When Builder genuinely needs Jacob, return one plain-language reason and one smallest action; routine engineering failures must not be escalated as human decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Needs-user state contains one actionable request.
Tests distinguish human gates from retryable implementation/provider/infrastructure failures.
validation_commands: cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run AgentWorkspacePanel

packets.title: Show the model that actually answered
packets.objective: Carry actual provider/model identity from the completed room turn into durable result metadata and user-visible detail without trusting the requested alias as proof.
acceptance_criteria: Actual provider/model is shown only when execution evidence supplies it.
Requested and actual identity cannot be silently conflated.
validation_commands: cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run AgentWorkspacePanel

packets.title: Resume a room after Gateway restart
packets.objective: Prove durable workspace state reconstructs the current turn, proposal/approval state and final result after process restart without replaying side effects.
acceptance_criteria: Restart preserves conversation/result state.
Restart does not duplicate proposal, approval or Builder submission.

packets.title: Make provider failure recoverable in-product
packets.objective: For a failed model-backed room turn, preserve raw diagnostics in operator evidence while presenting one cause and a safe retry/change-provider action in the workspace.
acceptance_criteria: User copy contains no host, port, env var, stack trace or provider-chain dump.
Retry cannot duplicate a previously accepted Builder proposal.
validation_commands: cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run AgentWorkspacePanel

packets.title: Deduplicate workspace result events
packets.objective: Ensure retry, refresh and restart cannot emit duplicate final-result or needs-user events for the same completed turn.
acceptance_criteria: One logical terminal transition produces one user-visible result event.
Event dedupe survives restart.

packets.title: Separate progress from needs-attention
packets.objective: Expose a deterministic attention state so ordinary working/progress does not demand Jacob's input while genuine approval or blocker states do.
acceptance_criteria: Working and informational states are not marked needs-user.
Approval/blocker states identify the exact user action.
validation_commands: cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run AgentWorkspacePanel

packets.title: Translate Builder progress into a few human stages
packets.objective: Map durable Builder state to a small set of understandable workspace stages such as preparing, working, checking, needs-you, done and failed without exposing internal packet machinery.
acceptance_criteria: Primary UI uses bounded human stages.
Raw Builder state remains inspectable but is not required to understand progress.
validation_commands: cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run AgentWorkspacePanel

packets.title: Keep internal Builder jargon out of primary workspace copy
packets.objective: Add a regression guard against packet IDs, KTF terms, gateway ports, env vars, MCP plumbing and raw exception class names appearing as primary user messages.
acceptance_criteria: Known internal terms are absent from primary success/failure copy fixtures.
Optional developer evidence is not removed.
validation_commands: cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run AgentWorkspacePanel

packets.title: Keep the workspace usable at phone width
packets.objective: Add focused component/browser-level regression evidence for the Agent Workspace at an iPhone-class width: no document overflow, clipped primary action or obscured result/approval control.
acceptance_criteria: Primary workspace controls remain inside the phone viewport.
A seeded overflow/clipping regression fails the test.

packets.title: Prove workspace failure mode with model service unavailable
packets.objective: Exercise the existing service-unavailable state through backend and component tests so the workspace fails closed with a recovery action instead of a dead control or fake success.
acceptance_criteria: Unavailable provider produces no successful completion claim.
Visible recovery action is consistent with backend failure state.
validation_commands: cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run AgentWorkspacePanel

packets.title: Lock the conversation-to-Builder proof into one deterministic fixture
packets.objective: Create one deterministic no-provider fixture covering conversation intent -> room proposal -> approval -> one durable Builder submission -> progress/result projection, with mocks only at the external model boundary and no fake Builder success.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture proves one submission and one final projected result with durable IDs/evidence.
A Builder failure remains failed and a replay/restart cannot duplicate execution.
